mapper.insert: INSERT INTO capsules ( user_id, title, memo, location, longitude, latitude, altitude, started_at, ended_at, created_at, color ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{memo}, CASE WHEN CAST(#{longitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE} AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NOT NULL AND CAST(#{latitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE} AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326) ELSE NULL END, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{altitude}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, NOW(), COALESCE(#{color}, '#4263EB') )

INSERT INTO capsule_images ( capsule_id, original_file_path, compressed_file_path, taken_at, created_at ) VALUES
( #{capsuleId}, #{img.originalFilePath}, #{img.compressedFilePath}, #{img.takenAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT c.capsule_id, c.user_id, c.title, CASE WHEN c.memo_visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND c.memo_deleted_at IS NULL THEN c.memo ELSE NULL END AS memo, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.altitude, c.started_at, c.ended_at, c.created_at, i.image_id, i.original_file_path, i.compressed_file_path, i.taken_at FROM capsules c LEFT JOIN capsule_images i ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.visibility = 'PUBLIC' WHERE ST_Contains( ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minLng}, #{minLat}, #{maxLng}, #{maxLat}, 4326), c.location ) AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, i.taken_at ASC LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capsules WHERE capsule_id = #{capsuleId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE #{path} IN (i.original_file_path, i.compressed_file_path) AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{admin} = TRUE OR (c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND i.visibility = 'PUBLIC'))

SELECT i.image_id AS "poiId", c.capsule_id AS "groupId", c.capsule_id AS "capsuleId", c.title AS "groupName", c.color AS "groupColor", COALESCE(i.title, c.title) AS title, COALESCE(i.poi_memo, c.memo) AS content, COALESCE(i.longitude, c.longitude) AS longitude, COALESCE(i.latitude, c.latitude) AS latitude, COALESCE(i.altitude, c.altitude, 0) AS altitude, i.original_file_path AS "originalFilePath", i.compressed_file_path AS "compressedFilePath", i.taken_at AS "takenAt", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM poi_shares s WHERE s.poi_id = i.image_id AND s.revoked_at IS NULL) AS shared FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.location IS NOT NULL AND i.location && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minLng}, #{minLat}, #{maxLng}, #{maxLat}, 4326)
AND c.capsule_id IN
#{groupId}
ORDER BY i.image_id LIMIT 1000

SELECT i.image_id AS "poiId", c.capsule_id AS "groupId", c.capsule_id AS "capsuleId", c.title AS "groupName", c.color AS "groupColor", COALESCE(i.title, c.title) AS title, COALESCE(i.poi_memo, c.memo) AS content, COALESCE(i.longitude, c.longitude) AS longitude, COALESCE(i.latitude, c.latitude) AS latitude, COALESCE(i.altitude, c.altitude, 0) AS altitude, i.original_file_path AS "originalFilePath", i.compressed_file_path AS "compressedFilePath", i.taken_at AS "takenAt", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM poi_shares s WHERE s.poi_id = i.image_id AND s.revoked_at IS NULL) AS shared FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE i.image_id = #{poiId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT i.image_id AS "poiId", c.capsule_id AS "groupId", c.capsule_id AS "capsuleId", c.title AS "groupName", c.color AS "groupColor", COALESCE(i.title, c.title) AS title, COALESCE(i.poi_memo, c.memo) AS content, COALESCE(i.longitude, c.longitude) AS longitude, COALESCE(i.latitude, c.latitude) AS latitude, COALESCE(i.altitude, c.altitude, 0) AS altitude, i.original_file_path AS "originalFilePath", i.compressed_file_path AS "compressedFilePath", i.taken_at AS "takenAt" FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE i.image_id = #{poiId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF i
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poi_history(poi_id,capsule_id,title,content,original_file_path,compressed_file_path, location,longitude,latitude,altitude,poi_updated_at,changed_by,change_type) SELECT i.image_id, i.capsule_id, COALESCE(i.title,c.title,'나의 3D 추억'), COALESCE(i.poi_memo,c.memo), i.original_file_path,i.compressed_file_path, i.location,i.longitude,i.latitude,i.altitude,i.updated_at,#{changedBy},#{changeType} FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE i.image_id = #{poiId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO capsule_images(capsule_id, original_file_path, compressed_file_path, taken_at, title, poi_memo, longitude, latitude, altitude, location) SELECT #{capsuleId}, #{originalPath}, #{compressedPath}, NOW(), #{title}, #{content}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{altitude}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{altitude}), 4326) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM capsules WHERE capsule_id = #{capsuleId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT i.image_id FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id=i.capsule_id WHERE i.original_file_path=#{originalPath} AND c.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY i.image_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT h.history_id AS "historyId", h.title, h.content, h.capsule_id AS "capsuleId", h.original_file_path AS "originalFilePath", h.compressed_file_path AS "compressedFilePath", h.longitude, h.latitude, h.altitude, h.change_type AS "changeType", h.archived_at AS "archivedAt" FROM poi_history h JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id=h.capsule_id WHERE h.poi_id=#{poiId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY h.archived_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE capsule_images i SET title = #{title}, poi_memo = #{content}, capsule_id = #{groupId}, updated_at = NOW(), original_file_path = COALESCE(#{originalPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, i.original_file_path), compressed_file_path = COALESCE(#{compressedPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, i.compressed_file_path) FROM capsules c, capsules destination WHERE i.image_id = #{poiId} AND c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND destination.capsule_id = #{groupId} AND destination.user_id = #{userId} AND destination.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE capsule_images i SET deleted_at = NOW(), visibility = 'PRIVATE' FROM capsules c WHERE i.image_id = #{poiId} AND c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT c.capsule_id AS "groupId", c.title AS name, c.color, COUNT(i.image_id) FILTER (WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "poiCount", c.visibility FROM capsules c LEFT JOIN capsule_images i ON i.capsule_id = c.capsule_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.capsule_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE capsules SET title=#{name}, color=#{color}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE capsule_id=#{groupId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE capsules SET visibility=#{visibility}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE capsule_id=#{groupId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE capsules SET deleted_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW(), visibility='PRIVATE' WHERE capsule_id=#{groupId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capsule_images WHERE capsule_id=#{groupId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id=i.capsule_id WHERE c.capsule_id=#{groupId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poi_shares(poi_id, owner_id, token_hash) SELECT i.image_id, #{userId}, #{tokenHash} FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id=i.capsule_id WHERE i.image_id=#{poiId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE poi_shares SET revoked_at=NOW() WHERE poi_id=#{poiId} AND owner_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT i.image_id AS "poiId", c.capsule_id AS "groupId", c.capsule_id AS "capsuleId", c.title AS "groupName", c.color AS "groupColor", COALESCE(i.title,c.title) AS title, COALESCE(i.poi_memo,c.memo) AS content, COALESCE(i.longitude,c.longitude) AS longitude, COALESCE(i.latitude,c.latitude) AS latitude, COALESCE(i.altitude,c.altitude,0) AS altitude, i.original_file_path AS "originalFilePath", i.compressed_file_path AS "compressedFilePath", i.taken_at AS "takenAt", TRUE AS shared FROM poi_shares s JOIN capsule_images i ON i.image_id=s.poi_id JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id=i.capsule_id WHERE s.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE capsules SET memo = CASE WHEN COALESCE(memo, '') = '' THEN #{memo} WHEN #{memo} = '' THEN memo ELSE memo || E'\n\n' || #{memo} END, location = COALESCE(location, CASE WHEN CAST(#{longitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE} AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NOT NULL AND CAST(#{latitude,jdbcType=DOUBLE} AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326) ELSE NULL END), longitude = COALESCE(longitude, #{longitude}), latitude = COALESCE(latitude, #{latitude}), altitude = COALESCE(altitude, #{altitude}) WHERE capsule_id = #{capsuleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.capsule_id, c.user_id, c.title, CASE WHEN c.memo_visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND c.memo_deleted_at IS NULL THEN c.memo ELSE NULL END AS memo, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.altitude, c.started_at, c.ended_at, c.created_at, i.image_id, i.original_file_path, i.compressed_file_path, i.taken_at FROM capsules c LEFT JOIN capsule_images i ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.visibility = 'PUBLIC' WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, i.taken_at ASC
